title: Wrap announce persistence read/fstat OSError as AnnouncePersistenceError
description: P3 (wave-2 review of worker6-r2ow): python/src/lichen/announce/persistence.py _read_state wraps only os.open; the os.read (~:278) and the NEW post-read re-fstat (~:280) can raise raw OSError (EIO/ESTALE), escaping as bare OSError instead of the method's documented failure type AnnouncePersistenceError. Callers treat both as terminal today (scheduler.py:173 wraps Exception; processor declares persistence failure terminal) so behavior is at parity, but the contract is inconsistent and the new guard added one more unwrapped syscall. Fix: wrap the read+re-fstat body (keep the finally fd close) and add an EIO-injection test asserting AnnouncePersistenceError.
